scope: measured surrogate (IdentifiedSim) on seeded synthetic scenarios and courses, and open-loop replays of live logs; development evidence, not flight evidence

hairpin_brain08.threshold: clean passes (finished, no contact) >= 0; wall contacts <= 10; scenarios with any contact <= baseline; ceiling contacts <= baseline + 1

hairpin_brain09b.threshold: clean passes (finished, no contact) >= 7; wall contacts <= 2; scenarios with any contact <= baseline; ceiling contacts <= baseline + 1

hairpin_brain10b.threshold: clean passes (finished, no contact) >= 6; wall contacts <= 3; scenarios with any contact <= baseline; ceiling contacts <= baseline + 1

accelerate_brain08.threshold: mean height loss <= 60% of the baseline's; floor and ceiling contacts, crashes <= baseline; finishes >= baseline; paired finish time <= baseline x 1.05

accelerate_brain09b.threshold: mean height loss <= 60% of the baseline's; floor and ceiling contacts, crashes <= baseline; finishes >= baseline; paired finish time <= baseline x 1.05

accelerate_brain10b.threshold: mean height loss <= baseline + 0.05 m; floor and ceiling contacts, crashes <= baseline; finishes >= baseline; paired finish time <= baseline x 1.05

dev16_brain08.threshold: finishes >= baseline; crashes <= baseline; chatter <= 1.15 x baseline; paired finish time <= baseline x 1.03; terrain contacts <= baseline + 1; passes > 1.5 m high <= baseline + 2

dev16_brain09b.threshold: finishes >= baseline; crashes <= baseline; chatter <= 1.15 x baseline; paired finish time <= baseline x 1.03; terrain contacts <= baseline + 1; passes > 1.5 m high <= baseline + 2

dev16_brain10b.threshold: finishes >= baseline; crashes <= baseline; chatter <= 1.15 x baseline; paired finish time <= baseline x 1.03; terrain contacts <= baseline + 1; passes > 1.5 m high <= baseline + 2

hill_brain08.threshold: finishes >= baseline; crashes <= baseline; chatter <= 1.15 x baseline; paired finish time <= baseline x 1.03; terrain contacts <= baseline + 1; passes > 1.5 m high <= baseline + 2

hill_brain09b.threshold: finishes >= baseline; crashes <= baseline; chatter <= 1.15 x baseline; paired finish time <= baseline x 1.03; terrain contacts <= baseline + 1; passes > 1.5 m high <= baseline + 2

hill_brain10b.threshold: finishes >= baseline; crashes <= baseline; chatter <= 1.15 x baseline; paired finish time <= baseline x 1.03; terrain contacts <= baseline + 1; passes > 1.5 m high <= baseline + 2

window_minus-brain09b-r4-01_22.95.threshold: the unassisted surrogate reproduces the live lowest height within 0.15 m; assisted lowest height >= unassisted + 0.2 m

window_minus-brain10b-r4-02_20.2.threshold: the unassisted surrogate reproduces the live speed at the window end within 0.5 m/s; assisted <= unassisted - 1.0 m/s

identity.threshold: every pair bit-identical (per-tick request, yaw, state, cap, climb, descent scale)

quiet.threshold: per clean lap log: no more turn-first episodes than without the assist; horizontal request removed <= 3% of the flown distance; the stopping bound active <= 1.0 s per minute (open loop: upper bounds)

hairpin_flatray.note: report only: the governor cap along the horizontal part of its ray (a stand-in for the round-4b contact fix, which another branch owns); not a gate
